name: caracara-archicad
description: Drive a running Archicad instance through the Tapir add-on and Archicad's JSON API.
long_description:
Local MCP server for a running Archicad session. Discovers active instances, lists available Archicad API commands, retrieves each command's schema, and executes them.

This can create, modify, and delete elements; open, close, and save projects; export files (IFC, BCF, favorites); and send or receive Teamwork. Project names, paths, and model data are sent to the MCP client. Turn on read-only mode in the settings to let the AI look without changing anything. Requires Archicad open on this machine, and the Tapir Archicad Add-On for the full command set.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Let the AI look at your projects but never change, delete, save or export anything.

allow_images.title: Allow pictures of the design
allow_images.description: Let the AI take screenshots of Archicad to check its work. The pictures are uploaded to your AI provider. They help the AI check its work, but each picture uses more tokens and more of the conversation's context. Off by default.

allow_session_commands.title: Allow closing and replacing the open project
allow_session_commands.description: Let the AI close the open project or start a new one. Archicad discards any unsaved changes when that happens, and the AI cannot tell whether you have unsaved work. Off by default; read-only mode still blocks these commands.

tools.name: discovery_list_active_archicads
tools.description: Lists running Archicad instances and their ports.

tools.name: archicad_list_commands
tools.description: Lists all available Archicad API commands.

tools.name: archicad_get_command_schema
tools.description: Returns the JSON schema for a specific Archicad command.

tools.name: archicad_call_tool
tools.description: Executes an Archicad API command against a target instance. Includes commands that modify the model, export files, and interact with Teamwork.

tools.name: archicad_read_tool
tools.description: Executes an Archicad API command that only reads (Get, Is, Filter), so the client can allow it without asking.

tools.name: archicad_get_job
tools.description: Retrieves a running or finished execution by handle, or lists retained jobs to recover a lost response.

tools.name: archicad_query
tools.description: Finds elements by type, selection, classification or filter and returns a set handle, their count or the fields asked for.

tools.name: archicad_mutate
tools.description: Changes, moves, rotates, highlights or deletes a set of elements as one Undo step, after checking for missing and locked elements; dry_run previews the change.

tools.name: archicad_build
tools.description: Creates walls, columns, beams, slabs, roofs, zones, doors and windows from one checked list, with a dry run, and returns everything made as one set.

tools.name: archicad_calculate
tools.description: Runs one read-only SQL query over the quantities and building materials of a set of elements, for exact totals.

tools.name: archicad_project_overview
tools.description: Returns stories, units, layers, classification systems and north direction; private project details only on request.

tools.name: archicad_spatial_query
tools.description: Finds elements near, inside or colliding with the elements of another set.

tools.name: archicad_capture_view
tools.description: Returns a picture of the Archicad window or of one element. Offered only when pictures are allowed in the settings.
